hook: What if 6,560 square miles of the Atacama Desert suddenly transformed into a massive garden?

sections.voiceover: What if 6,560 square miles of the Atacama Desert suddenly transformed into a massive garden?
b_roll: Wide shot of dry, cracked desert landscape

sections.voiceover: In 2026, an intense El Nino weather pattern brought record rainfall to the Atacama Desert in Chile. How much of the Atacama Desert changed during this 2026 event?
b_roll: Close-up of dormant seeds in dry soil
Map of Chile highlighting the Atacama

sections.voiceover: This rare Desierto Florido event covers 17,000 square kilometers, transforming the arid landscape into color.
CONAF and SBAP confirm this bloom triggers 23% of the desert's dormant underground seed bank.
b_roll: Aerial view of colorful wildflower fields

sections.voiceover: This bloom marks the most extensive event since 1997.
b_roll: Wide scenic shot of desert wildflowers
